metadata.title: Platform DNS Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for providing governed, reliable name resolution as foundational platform infrastructure.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Platform-level DNS resolution, recursion, caching, and zoning services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern establishing DNS as a governed platform service rather than an implicit utility.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Platform DNS depends on foundational platform availability, compute, and network capabilities.

metadata.remarks: Platform DNS Core defines baseline trust assumptions for DNS as a critical platform capability. It establishes ownership, scope, and separation of responsibilities between resolution mechanics, data governance, application naming intent, and boundary enforcement.

components.title: Platform DNS Governance
components.description: Establishes DNS as an intentional, governed platform service with clear accountability boundaries.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or abuse of infrastructure configuration due to lack of governance.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy-governed infrastructure services with explicit ownership and constraints.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Platform services, including DNS, are governed by policy and assigned accountability.

components.title: Platform DNS Boundary Definition
components.description: Defines trust boundaries between DNS resolution behavior and higher-level naming, data, and exposure concerns.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of implicit trust boundaries in shared infrastructure services.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit trust boundary definition between infrastructure mechanics and policy enforcement.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Platform service boundaries are defined to prevent implicit exposure or unintended delegation.
